hypothesis: The selected row-parallel r-k-c parent is valid at 0.009476691 s. Earlier row-parallel variants with explicit SIMD and with k unrolling plus SIMD were also valid but slower (0.010415142 s and 0.009647238 s). It may reduce repeated C read-modify-write traffic, at the cost of accessing B in column chunks; the outcome is unmeasured.
